title: Chapter 1 Heavy Fog
content:
Chapter 1 Heavy Fog

Wang Shuo woke up from the cold.

When I opened my eyes, there was heavy fog all around.

10 meters away, invisible object.

The biting cold wind howled, and he couldn't help but shiver all over.

"Where am I?"

Wang Shuo seemed to have lost his drink, and his head was a little dizzy.

After thinking for a long time, he remembered.

He had just finished buying fresh meat buns and planned to take the bus across the street.

"Damn, where's my fresh meat bun?"

He rubbed his stiff hands and stood up with difficulty.

He hurriedly fumbled around in his pockets, but found nothing.

My wallet, cell phone, and keys are all gone.

"It's over."

A feeling of annoyance at having lost something, mixed with a sense of uneasiness about a strange place, suddenly rose in his heart.

He seemed to have lost all his strength and collapsed on the ground. He was stunned for a while before he came back to his senses.

The situation was like this, and there was no point in complaining. He took a deep breath and cheered up.

There was a fire pit in front of him, and the bonfire in the fire pit had been extinguished.

On a stone next to the firepit, there is a dark brown notebook.

He circled the notebook and observed it for a while, but found nothing unusual.

Wang Shuo hesitated for a while and then picked it up.

【bite! Obtain "Survivor's Manual\
